title: Merge Trees of Length-Filtered Lattice Knot Spaces
summary: We study length-filtered BFACF graphs of self-avoiding polygons in the simple cubic lattice, with merge heights recording the least length cap needed to connect configurations. We determine the complete minimal-layer merge trees for $4_1$ (four components at length 30 merging at 32) and $6_3$ (twelve components at length 40, two at 42, and one at 44). For one trefoil chirality, we certify six selected nonminimal components born at length 26 and merging with the minimal branch by length 28 or 30; these do not exhaust the full filtration.
